name: realtor-ai-editing-studio
description: The AI Editing Studio: a full-time video editor inside the agent's Claude, on the engine they choose: their Riverside account (any Claude surface) or Instagram's free Edits app for Mac (Claude Code on their Mac; no per-edit fees). 28 skills in five stages: DIRECT (creative direction, record coach, transcript read, section map), CUT (remove the fluff, hook finder, rescue cut, interview edit), POLISH (audio, color and look, captions, music, B-roll, B-roll library, brand graphics, energy), REPURPOSE (reels, weekly batch, podcast, trailer), SHIP (quality check, review and revise, publish), plus setup, a navigator that resumes stopped edits, and three recipes. Every change is verified: revision diffs on Riverside, rendered frames and the export on Edits. Publishing only on an explicit yes (Riverside); Edits exports and the agent shares. It never writes titles, descriptions, chapter names, or captions. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) and a Riverside Grow plan or higher, or a Mac with Edits.
